title: What the saxophone really cost
summary: Follow-up on the price paid for the saxophone ($50 against the asked $60) and the trick of the three keys.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Did Louie ever twist those three keys back again?
Oh, when we go to the place, he said, he's got to buy it. Bram, bram, bram. He had told me, he had told me, listen, he said, $60, I'm going to get that cheaper for you. What did you pay? $10?
No, he paid $50 instead of $60. $50. What did you have to pay? $60. And how much did you really pay then?
But the hardware cost $60. Look at the trickster on that. It takes $10 for a pay.
Take it then. Take it then.
